sentences: Ringworm, also known as tinea corporis, is a fungal infection caused by dermatophytes, a type of fungus that infects the outer layer of the skin
The most common causative agents of ringworm are Trichophyton rubrum, Trichophyton mentagrophytes, and Microsporum canis
Ringworm is typically spread through direct contact with an infected person or animal, contaminated objects, or contaminated soil
It can also be spread through sharing personal items such as towels, clothing, or combs
The infection can also be transmitted through contact with an infected animal, such as a cat or dog
Risk factors for developing ringworm include skin-to-skin contact with an infected person or animal, sharing personal items, and having a weakened immune system
People with compromised immune systems, such as those with diabetes or taking immunosuppressive medications, are more susceptible to ringworm infections
Symptoms of ringworm include a circular, itchy rash with a clear center, often accompanied by redness, scaling, and inflammation
The rash can appear anywhere on the body, but it is most commonly found on the arms, legs, and torso
Treatment for ringworm typically involves topical or oral antifungal medications, such as terbinafine or itraconazole
In severe cases, oral antifungal medications may be prescribed
It is essential to complete the full course of treatment to prevent recurrence and spread of the infection
